formulas.ascii: Spatial error model y = Xb + u, u = lambda W u + e (spreg GM_Error_Hom, A1 = hom_sc, one iteration; estimator kelejian-prucha is GM_Error). Step 1: OLS residuals u give moments u'A1u, u'A2u with A1 = (W'W - (t/n) I)/(1 + (t/n)^2), t = tr(W'W), A2 = (W + W')/2; r(lambda) = A lambda + B lambda^2 - g is minimised unweighted on a grid in [-0.99/||W||_inf, 0.99/||W||_inf] refined by bisection. Step 2: FGLS betas at that lambda, moments recomputed on their residuals and weighted by psi^-1. Final: y_s = y - lambda W y, X_s = X - lambda W X (filtered constant included); beta = (Xs'Xs)^-1 Xs'ys, sigma2 = u_s'u_s/n. Standard errors treat lambda as known; lambda has its own standard error.
y[i] = sum(x[s(i)..i-1+delta]) mod 2^32; delta=0 exclusive (default), 1 inclusive; s(i) is the last nonzero segment flag or 0.
